stages.name: regular season
stages.note: Each club plays the other 11 three times (22 matches home-and-away, then 11 more).

stages.name: championship group
stages.note: Top six after 33 rounds, single round robin.

stages.name: relegation group
stages.note: Bottom six after 33 rounds, single round robin.

playoff.entries: 11th in the Premiership vs winner of the Championship 2nd-4th ladder
playoff.note: The 12th-placed club is relegated directly; 11th defends its place over two legs.
3rd v 4th over two legs, then 2nd v that winner over two legs; the winner meets the Premiership 11th over two legs. The league also has a relegation tie: 9th v the League One ladder winner, two legs.
3rd v 4th, then 2nd v that winner, both two-legged; the winner meets the Championship 9th over two legs. Relegation tie: 9th v the League Two ladder winner, two legs.

3rd v 4th, then 2nd v that winner, both two-legged; the winner meets League One 9th over two legs. The bottom club (Club 42) plays the tier-5 play-off winner over two legs, subject to a bronze SFA licence.

boundaries.note: Championship champion goes up directly; 2nd-4th play a two-legged ladder and its winner meets the Premiership 11th over two legs. Premiership 12th goes down directly, 11th only through that same tie, so one place moves through it.
League One champion up directly, 2nd-4th ladder winner meets the Championship 9th over two legs. Championship 10th down directly, 9th only through that tie.
League Two champion up directly, 2nd-4th ladder winner meets League One 9th over two legs. League One 10th down directly, 9th only through that tie.

notes: Levels 2-4 are 10-club quadruple round robins (36 rounds, four meetings per pair); the Premiership is a 12-club split league (33 + 5 = 38). Every boundary is 1 direct + 1 play-off in each direction, and the play-off place is a single shared two-legged final, so up/down are not independent. League Two has no automatic relegation: its bottom club (Club 42) meets the tier-5 play-off winner over two legs, and from 2026-27 tier 5 is Highland plus Lowland East and Lowland West, whose three champions play off first; promotion needs a bronze SFA licence. Tier 5 and below are not in our dataset, hence closed_down=true for SC4.
